mentions.name: retcon
mentions.description: This tool is a middleman layer for Claude Code that lets the AI agent edit its own conversation history or rewind itself to a previous round. Named for the verb recontextualize, it flips the rewind model: instead of the user typing a /rewind command, the AI retcons its own past turns so earlier mistakes no longer fight the user's corrections.
mentions.problem: When an AI misunderstands a request, users correct it by words, but the messed-up turn stays in context and the AI keeps fighting both the correction and its own past mistake.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am building retcon (https://github.com/WujiLabs/retcon), a Claude Code middleman layer allowing the AI agent to edit its own conversation history or rewind itself to a previous round.
